topic: 定语从句（Attributive Clauses）全阶突破与实战
teaching_notes:
1. 【核心概念】：定语从句就像给名词穿上的“专属定制小外套”或贴上的“说明标签”。用来修饰和限定前面的名词（先行词）。
2. 【语法公式与口诀】：
   - 基本结构：先行词（人/物）+ 关系词（who/which/that/whose/where/when...）+ 从句。
   - 记忆口诀：人用 who，物用 which，that 广适用；关系代词做主宾，whose 后面紧跟名；介词后面看清人，whom/which 才能跟；标点逗号隔离时，that 绝对要隐身！
3. 【避坑指南】：
   - 错误1：关系词与代词重复叠加（如：The boy who he is running... 错！应删去 he）。
   - 错误2：介词后误用 that（如：The house in that I live... 错！介词后指物必须用 which）。
   - 错误3：忽视主谓一致（如：The books that is on the desk... 错！先行词 books 为复数，从句谓语应为 are）。
4. 【经典例句】：
   - The girl who is reading under the big tree is my best friend.（在树下看书的那个女孩是我最好的朋友。）
   - I lost the shiny watch which my dad gave me for my birthday.（我弄丢了我爸爸送我的生日手表。）
   - This is the ancient castle whose roof is covered with white snow.（这就是那座屋顶覆盖着白雪的古老城堡。）

questions.question: The boy _____ lives next door is a talented pianist.
questions.explanation: 考查关系代词。先行词是 The boy（人），在从句中作主语，故用 who。

questions.question: This is the storybook _____ I borrowed from the school library yesterday.
questions.explanation: 考查关系代词。先行词是 storybook（物），从句缺少宾语，故用 which（或 that）。

questions.question: Look at the cute puppy _____ tail is short and fluffy!
questions.explanation: 考查关系代词。先行词是 puppy，与 tail 构成所属关系（小狗的尾巴），故用 whose。

questions.question: Mr. Li is the teacher _____ teaches us Science this term.
questions.explanation: 考查关系代词。先行词是 teacher（人），从句中作主语，故选 who。

questions.question: The apples _____ fell from the tree are sweet and juicy.
questions.explanation: 考查关系代词。先行词是 apples（物），在从句中作主语，可以用 that 或 which。

questions.question: Do you know the girl _____ is wearing a red hat over there?
questions.explanation: 考查关系代词。先行词是 girl（人），从句中缺少主语，故选 who。

questions.question: The toy robot _____ my uncle built for me can dance.
questions.explanation: 考查关系代词。先行词是 toy robot（物），从句中作 build 的宾语，故选 which。

questions.question: I have a classmate _____ dream is to become an astronaut.
questions.explanation: 考查关系代词。先行词 classmate 与从句名词 dream 是所属关系（同学的梦想），用 whose。

questions.question: Is this the computer _____ your father bought last week?
questions.explanation: 考查关系代词。先行词是 computer（物），从句中作 bought 的宾语，选 that。

questions.question: The children _____ are playing soccer in the playground look very happy.
questions.explanation: 考查关系代词。先行词是 children（人），从句中作主语，选 who。

questions.question: Here is the beautiful picture _____ my sister painted yesterday.
questions.explanation: 考查关系代词。先行词是 picture（物），在从句中作 painted 的宾语，用 which。

questions.question: The student _____ parents are both doctors always studies very hard.
questions.explanation: 考查关系代词。先行词是 student，表示“学生的父母”，使用所属关系的 whose。

questions.question: I like reading cartoon books _____ have funny drawings.
questions.explanation: 考查关系代词。先行词是 books（物），在从句中作主语，用 which。

questions.question: The lady _____ helped me find my lost bag was very friendly.
questions.explanation: 考查关系代词。先行词是 lady（人），从句中缺主语，用 who。

questions.question: Where is the blue pen _____ was on my desk just now?
questions.explanation: 考查关系代词。先行词是 pen（物），在从句中作主语，选项中只有 that 符合要求。

questions.question: The historic building in _____ my grandparents lived for half a century was restored last year.
questions.explanation: 考查“介词 + 关系代词”结构。介词 in 后面指物时不能用 that 或 where，必须用 which。

questions.question: Our headmaster, _____ all the students respect deeply, will deliver a speech at the ceremony.
questions.explanation: 考查非限制性定语从句。先行词是 headmaster（人），在从句中作 respect 的宾语，非限制性从句中指人作宾语用 whom（不能用 that）。

questions.question: The reason _____ he gave for being late to the competition sounded ridiculous.
questions.explanation: 考查考纲常考陷阱。虽然先行词是 reason，但从句 gave 缺少宾语（gave the reason），因此必须填关系代词 which/that，而非关系副词 why。

questions.question: This is the very laboratory _____ our research team conducted the physics experiment.
questions.explanation: 考查关系副词。先行词是 laboratory（地点），在从句中作地点状语（in the laboratory），故用关系副词 where。

questions.question: He managed to pass the final exam with high marks, _____ delighted his parents immensely.
questions.explanation: 考查非限制性定语从句。which 指代前面整个主句的情况（他期末考得高分这件事），在从句中作主语。

questions.question: All _____ can be done to protect the ancient cultural heritage has already been completed.
questions.explanation: 考查只能用 that 的情况。当先行词是不定代词 All 时，关系代词只能用 that，不能用 which。

questions.question: The mountain village, the name of _____ I cannot recall at the moment, is surrounded by lakes.
questions.explanation: 考查“the + 名词 + of + which”结构。the name of which 相当于 whose name，介词 of 后用 which。

questions.question: 2026 is the memorable year _____ our school will celebrate its 100th anniversary.
questions.explanation: 考查关系副词。先行词是 year（时间），从句结构完整，缺少时间状语（in the year），故用 when。

questions.question: Is there anything else _____ needs to be discussed before we conclude the meeting?
questions.explanation: 考查只能用 that 的情况。当先行词是被 anything, everything, nothing 等不定代词修饰或本身就是不定代词时，关系代词只能用 that。

questions.question: The famous scientist to _____ the Nobel Prize was awarded gave an inspiring speech.
questions.explanation: 考查“介词 + 关系代词”。介词 to 后修饰人时，只能用宾格形式 whom。

questions.question: The coastal city, _____ lies in the south of China, attracts millions of tourists each summer.
questions.explanation: 考查非限制性定语从句。从句缺少主语，先行词是 city（物），且有逗号隔开，只能用 which（逗号后绝对不用 that）。

questions.question: This is the very dictionary _____ I have been searching for in all local bookstores.
questions.explanation: 考查只能用 that 的情况。当先行词被 the very（恰好的、正是那个）修饰时，关系代词只能用 that。

questions.question: The author wrote a long novel, the main characters of _____ were based on real historical figures.
questions.explanation: 考查“the + 名词 + of + 关系代词”。指代先行词 novel（物），介词 of 后面填 which。

questions.question: The robotics workshop is a place _____ students can put theoretical knowledge into practice.
questions.explanation: 考查关系副词。先行词是 a place，在从句中作地点状语（in the place），故用关系副词 where。

questions.question: He wrote a detailed report, _____ contents were thoroughly examined by the committee.
questions.explanation: 考查非限制性定语从句中的所属关系。whose contents 相当于 the contents of which，表示“报告的内容”，作从句主语。
